en: Black‑and‑white postcard view of a stone wall with a bronze relief panel showing a central winged female figure with draped garments, flanked by several soldiers or historical figures holding flags or spears. To the right of the relief is a rectangular commemorative plaque fixed with four round bolts. In front of the wall is a densely planted flowerbed, and above the wall are parked cars and the façades of older multistory buildings, suggesting a European city street.
